## Overview（原文）

The SmartByte
LT-IS6320XG-4XS16GT-SD
is the highly reliable managed industrial Ethernet switch with 16-port 10/100/1000-T and 4-port 1G/2.5G/10GBase-X fiber optical interfaces. It also supports ERPS redundant network and the self-recovery mechanism is less than 20ms on full load which allows you to scheme a reliable Ethernet network by building a redundant ring topology as your back-up solution.
LT-IS6320XG-4XS16GT-SD
supports DI/DO/RS485,
it can work with temperature-humidity sensor to collect environmental data and trigger alarms, which is critical for the industrial application requiring the stable ambient conditions
LT-IS6320XG-4XS16GT-SD
is the high cost-effective easy-to-use device, which provides essential industrial Ethernet networking function, including wide range power input 12-75VDC, redundant power design with polarity reverse protection, robust IP40 fan-less housing with Din-rail installation, wide operation
temperature from -40°C to 75°C as well as high-level EMI/EMC capability. It is the best choice for heavy industrial factory, transportation, oil & gas, chemical, IP Surveillance and processing automation area where environmental conditions are harsh and critical.

## Features（原文）

- 16*10/100/
- 1000Base-T RJ45, 4*1G/2.5G/10G
- Base-X SFP+
- Redundant
- power 12-75V input w
- ith polarity reverse/over-current protection
- Support DI/DO/RS485,
- work with temperature-humidity sensor to collect environment data and trigger alarms
- Support USB one key configuration & upgrading
- Layer 3 features: Support IPv4/IPv6 static routing, DHCP server, DHCP relay
- Layer 2 features: VLAN/GVRP/QinQ/SPAN/RSPAN/STP, RSTP, MSTP/DHCP/Multicast/ACL
- QoS/LLDP/802.1X/AAA/Loop Detect/Dying Gasp/SFP DDM/IPV6 managem
- ent/Dual Stack/ sFlow/W
- eb/SNMP/MQTT/Telnet/TFTP/Web upgrading
- Support G.8032 ERPS protocol,
- recovery time ≤20ms
- Support 6KV surge protection and ESD: Air-15kV, Contact-8kV Protection
- IP40 fan-less and Din-rail hardware design
- Operation temperature: -40 ℃ ~+75℃
